    Real-Time Car Jaune Bus Tracking with PostGIS¶

    Overview¶

    This notebook retrieves Car Jaune bus positions from the GTFS-RT feed, finds the nearest stop for each vehicle using the static GTFS, displays everything on an interactive map, and stores the current state of the network in a PostGIS table.

    Study Area: La Réunion (Car Jaune network)
    Role: Solo project
    Status: Completed

    Methods & Tools¶

    Data Sources

    • Car Jaune GTFS-RT feed (real-time vehicle positions): https://pysae.com/api/v2/groups/car-jaune/gtfs-rt
    • Car Jaune static GTFS (stops.txt, network stops): https://pysae.com/api/v2/groups/car-jaune/gtfs/pub

    Processing Steps

    1. Download the GTFS-RT feed and the static GTFS archive
    2. Load the stops (stops.txt) into a GeoDataFrame
    3. Compute the nearest stop for each bus (distance in metres, UTM 40S projection)
    4. Map buses and stops with Folium
    5. Create the PostGIS table and store the positions

    Tools Used

    Tool Purpose
    requests Downloading the GTFS-RT feed and static GTFS
    gtfs-realtime-bindings Decoding the GTFS-RT feed (protobuf)
    pandas / geopandas Reading stops, spatial data, reprojection
    shapely Point geometries for buses
    folium Interactive web map
    SQLAlchemy + psycopg2 Connecting to and writing in PostgreSQL
    PostgreSQL / PostGIS Storing positions (geometry(Point, 4326))

    Data¶

    Download the real-time feed (bus positions) and the static GTFS (stops), then load the stops into a GeoDataFrame in WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

    In [7]:
    Copied! 
    # --- URLs ---
GTFS_RT_URL = "https://pysae.com/api/v2/groups/car-jaune/gtfs-rt"
GTFS_STATIC_URL = "https://pysae.com/api/v2/groups/car-jaune/gtfs/pub"

# --- Fetch the GTFS-RT feed ---
r = requests.get(GTFS_RT_URL, timeout=20)
r.raise_for_status()
feed = gtfs_realtime_pb2.FeedMessage()
feed.ParseFromString(r.content)

# --- Fetch the static GTFS (stops) ---
resp = requests.get(GTFS_STATIC_URL, timeout=20)
resp.raise_for_status()
with open("carjaune_gtfs.zip", "wb") as f:
    f.write(resp.content)
    # --- URLs --- GTFS_RT_URL = "https://pysae.com/api/v2/groups/car-jaune/gtfs-rt" GTFS_STATIC_URL = "https://pysae.com/api/v2/groups/car-jaune/gtfs/pub" # --- Fetch the GTFS-RT feed --- r = requests.get(GTFS_RT_URL, timeout=20) r.raise_for_status() feed = gtfs_realtime_pb2.FeedMessage() feed.ParseFromString(r.content) # --- Fetch the static GTFS (stops) --- resp = requests.get(GTFS_STATIC_URL, timeout=20) resp.raise_for_status() with open("carjaune_gtfs.zip", "wb") as f: f.write(resp.content)

    Analysis¶

    Nearest stop for each bus¶

    For each vehicle, the stops and the bus are reprojected to UTM zone 40S (EPSG:32740) so distances are in metres, and the stop with the minimum distance is kept. Bus markers are added to their Folium layer along the way.

    In [11]:
    Copied! 
    # --- Create two FeatureGroups (buses and stops) ---
bus_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="CarJaune buses")
stops_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="CarJaune stops")

# --- Colour palette to tell buses apart ---
colors = ["blue", "red", "green", "orange", "purple", "darkred", "cadetblue"]

def get_color(bus_id):
    return colors[hash(bus_id) % len(colors)]
    # --- Create two FeatureGroups (buses and stops) --- bus_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="CarJaune buses") stops_layer = folium.FeatureGroup(name="CarJaune stops") # --- Colour palette to tell buses apart --- colors = ["blue", "red", "green", "orange", "purple", "darkred", "cadetblue"] def get_color(bus_id): return colors[hash(bus_id) % len(colors)]
    In [12]:
    Copied! 
    # --- Prepare the bus data ---
rows = []
for entity in feed.entity:
    if entity.HasField("vehicle"):
        v = entity.vehicle
        pos = v.position
        lat, lon = pos.latitude, pos.longitude
        bus_id = entity.id
        ts = getattr(v, "timestamp", None)

        bus_point = Point(lon, lat)

        # Reproject to UTM zone 40S to compute distances in metres
        stops_proj = stops_gdf.to_crs(epsg=32740)
        bus_proj = gpd.GeoSeries([bus_point], crs="EPSG:4326").to_crs(epsg=32740).iloc[0]

        stops_proj["distance"] = stops_proj.geometry.distance(bus_proj)
        nearest_stop = stops_proj.loc[stops_proj["distance"].idxmin()]
        stop_info = f"Near stop {nearest_stop['stop_name']} ({nearest_stop['distance']:.0f} m)"

        passage_time = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") if ts else "N/A"

        # Add the bus to the map
        folium.Marker(
            location=[lat, lon],
            popup=f"Bus {bus_id}<br>Time: {passage_time}<br>{stop_info}",
            tooltip=f"Car Jaune {bus_id}",
            icon=folium.Icon(color=get_color(bus_id), icon="bus", prefix="fa")
        ).add_to(bus_layer)

        # Prepare for PostGIS
        rows.append({
            "vehicle_id": bus_id,
            "timestamp": ts,
            "geometry": bus_point,
            "nearest_stop": nearest_stop["stop_name"]
        })
    # --- Prepare the bus data --- rows = [] for entity in feed.entity: if entity.HasField("vehicle"): v = entity.vehicle pos = v.position lat, lon = pos.latitude, pos.longitude bus_id = entity.id ts = getattr(v, "timestamp", None) bus_point = Point(lon, lat) # Reproject to UTM zone 40S to compute distances in metres stops_proj = stops_gdf.to_crs(epsg=32740) bus_proj = gpd.GeoSeries([bus_point], crs="EPSG:4326").to_crs(epsg=32740).iloc[0] stops_proj["distance"] = stops_proj.geometry.distance(bus_proj) nearest_stop = stops_proj.loc[stops_proj["distance"].idxmin()] stop_info = f"Near stop {nearest_stop['stop_name']} ({nearest_stop['distance']:.0f} m)" passage_time = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(ts).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") if ts else "N/A" # Add the bus to the map folium.Marker( location=[lat, lon], popup=f"Bus {bus_id}<br>Time: {passage_time}<br>{stop_info}", tooltip=f"Car Jaune {bus_id}", icon=folium.Icon(color=get_color(bus_id), icon="bus", prefix="fa") ).add_to(bus_layer) # Prepare for PostGIS rows.append({ "vehicle_id": bus_id, "timestamp": ts, "geometry": bus_point, "nearest_stop": nearest_stop["stop_name"] })

    Storing in PostGIS¶

    Positions are stored in the table public.carjaune_vehicles_rt:

    Column Type Description
    vehicle_id text (primary key) Vehicle identifier
    timestamp bigint Unix timestamp of the observation
    geom geometry(Point, 4326) Bus position
    nearest_stop text Name of the nearest stop

    On each run, the table is emptied and refilled with the latest positions.

    In [17]:
    Copied! 
    # --- Postgres/PostGIS connection ---
PG_DSN = "postgresql+psycopg2://postgres:myproject@localhost:5432/China"
SCHEMA = "public"
TABLE = "carjaune_vehicles_rt"
engine = create_engine(PG_DSN, future=True)
    # --- Postgres/PostGIS connection --- PG_DSN = "postgresql+psycopg2://postgres:myproject@localhost:5432/China" SCHEMA = "public" TABLE = "carjaune_vehicles_rt" engine = create_engine(PG_DSN, future=True)
    In [18]:
    Copied! 
    # --- Create the table if it does not exist ---
with engine.begin() as conn:
    conn.execute(text(f"""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {SCHEMA}.{TABLE} (
            vehicle_id text PRIMARY KEY,
            timestamp bigint,
            geom geometry(Point, 4326)
        );
    """))
    # --- Create the table if it does not exist --- with engine.begin() as conn: conn.execute(text(f""" CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {SCHEMA}.{TABLE} ( vehicle_id text PRIMARY KEY, timestamp bigint, geom geometry(Point, 4326) ); """))

with engine.begin() as conn:
    conn.execute(text(f"""
        ALTER TABLE {SCHEMA}.{TABLE}
        ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS nearest_stop text;
    """))
    # --- Add the nearest_stop column if it does not exist --- with engine.begin() as conn: conn.execute(text(f""" ALTER TABLE {SCHEMA}.{TABLE} ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS nearest_stop text; """))

    # --- Convert to a GeoDataFrame ---
gdf_buses = gpd.GeoDataFrame(rows, geometry="geometry", crs="EPSG:4326")
    # --- Convert to a GeoDataFrame --- gdf_buses = gpd.GeoDataFrame(rows, geometry="geometry", crs="EPSG:4326")
    In [21]:
    Copied! 
    # --- Delete old rows, then insert the new ones ---
with engine.begin() as conn:
    conn.execute(text(f"DELETE FROM {SCHEMA}.{TABLE};"))

    for _, r in gdf_buses.iterrows():
        conn.execute(text(f"""
            INSERT INTO {SCHEMA}.{TABLE} (vehicle_id, timestamp, geom, nearest_stop)
            VALUES (:vehicle_id, :timestamp, ST_GeomFromText(:wkt, 4326), :nearest_stop);
        """), {
            "vehicle_id": r["vehicle_id"],
            "timestamp": r["timestamp"],
            "wkt": r.geometry.wkt,
            "nearest_stop": r["nearest_stop"]
        })

print(f"[OK] {len(gdf_buses)} vehicles inserted with their nearest stop")
    # --- Delete old rows, then insert the new ones --- with engine.begin() as conn: conn.execute(text(f"DELETE FROM {SCHEMA}.{TABLE};")) for _, r in gdf_buses.iterrows(): conn.execute(text(f""" INSERT INTO {SCHEMA}.{TABLE} (vehicle_id, timestamp, geom, nearest_stop) VALUES (:vehicle_id, :timestamp, ST_GeomFromText(:wkt, 4326), :nearest_stop); """), { "vehicle_id": r["vehicle_id"], "timestamp": r["timestamp"], "wkt": r.geometry.wkt, "nearest_stop": r["nearest_stop"] }) print(f"[OK] {len(gdf_buses)} vehicles inserted with their nearest stop")
    [OK] 3 vehicles inserted with their nearest stop

gpd.read_postgis(
    f"SELECT vehicle_id, timestamp, nearest_stop, geom FROM {SCHEMA}.{TABLE}",

    Key Findings¶

    • Snapshot of 22/11/2025 around 21:55: 3 active vehicles in the GTFS-RT feed, against 458 stops in the static GTFS.
    • Each bus is matched to its nearest stop: La Veuve (about 1,020 m), Gare St-Louis (about 625 m) and RDT Etang-Salé (about 43 m).
    • Distances are straight-line (UTM 40S projection), not along the route: a nearby stop may sit across relief or on a different line.
    • The table is emptied before each insert, so it only holds the latest state of the network. To keep a history of passages, remove the DELETE and use a (vehicle_id, timestamp) key.
